K_likely_future_topology.minimum_plausible_native_precision_topol: THEORETICAL -- a single 24GB-class GPU (L4/L40/A10G) fits the ~29.3 GB BF16 weight set only with meaningfully reduced KV-cache headroom (close to the raw card capacity); a larger card gives more comfortable margin, matching the registry's own theoretical_gpu_count_l4_class_24gb.bf16=2 figure as the SAFER multi-GPU option.
K_likely_future_topology.safer_qualification_topology: THEORETICAL -- either 2x 24GB-class GPUs (TP2, per the registry's existing theoretical figure) or 1x 80GB+-class single GPU for comfortable single-GPU headroom
K_likely_future_topology.quantized_topology_options: THEORETICAL -- FP8 (~14.7 GB) and INT4 (~7.3 GB) both fit comfortably on a single 24GB-class GPU by weight size alone; no official quantized artifact confirmed this phase

N_zero_owner_cash_classification.rationale: No GPU execution was performed to determine this. The 29.3 GB BF16 weight footprint is tight on a single 24GB-class GPU and comfortable on a larger card; a future zero-cash smoke is plausible but not confirmed AVAILABLE_NOW absent a live credit-availability check. No promotional credits, account balance, or prior-phase credit state is assumed.

O_engine_decision.rationale: Phi3ForCausalLM is a mainstream, well-supported vLLM architecture with no confirmed model-specific blockers; ORNEUR's existing validated vLLM harness experience is a real implementation-risk advantage. SGLang not selected as fallback due to no confirmed official support evidence for this control this phase.
